name: Maskwood Nexus — creatures you control are every creature type, the Nexus is not
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). The changeling test matched "create a 2/2 blue Shapeshifter creature token with changeling", so the Nexus itself became every creature type and the real sentence was then skipped as a duplicate. The keyword is now read only on a keyword line. Your Bears are every creature type; the opponent's Bears are only a Bear.
